slides.title: 5 signs you need a phone curfew

slides.heading: you've watched _the sunrise_ from your bed
slides.top: not on purpose. _you just never stopped_
slides.text: the birds start up and you're _still on reels_

slides.heading: screen time _over 7 hours_
slides.top: and you _turned off the weekly report_
slides.text:
if you don't look

it's _not real_

slides.heading: you deleted tiktok and _got it back that night_
slides.text: deleting doesn't work when reinstalling is _one tap away_

slides.heading: screen time limit? you hit _"ignore"_
slides.text:
a limit you can skip

is just _a suggestion_

slides.heading: you need a curfew _you can't skip_
slides.text:
at bedtime my apps go to sleep and wake up _when i get up_

the only way out is _2 passes a month_

slides.question: how many hours was your screen time today? 👇
